All copy is placeholder and labeled MOCK; Instructor One/Two/Three are NOT real catalog entries; no real offer, discount, or date appears. The contest archetype is intentionally absent (compliance-gated). For a real send, every slot is QA-passed copy, every instructor is catalog-status-confirmed, and the build passes the full gate stack and the human gate.
